scope: Reconcile ODA native-DWG MTEXT flag layout, Autodesk and ezdxf DXF MTEXT profiles, and current ACadSharp MTEXT/SPLINE reports with existing local source, tests, and implementation-readiness gates.

method.kind: Primary-source web research plus targeted local source/test/plan inspection
localFilesInspected: src/drw_entities.cpp: DRW_MText DWG read/write flag gating and DWG MTEXT parsing
method.peerArtifactStatus: ACadSharp #1299 links a source-DWG/output-DXF ZIP. Opening the link returned a cache miss; the archive was not downloaded or inspected.

evidence.topic: Native DWG MTEXT flag 0x10 is R2018+ text-frame state with a version-scoped body payload
evidence.observed: ODA Open Design Specification §20.4.46 describes MTEXT background flags as BL/group 90. It defines bit 0x10 as text frame for R2018+ and places scale, CMC color, and transparency in the body when bit 0x01 is set or when the R2018+ 0x10 condition is met.
evidence.localObservation: Local top-level DRW_MText parseDwg/encodeDwg has the AC1032 condition. Existing object-vector tests cover record-body roundtrip and the following handle for flags 0/16/17 in AC1027 and AC1032.
evidence.disposition: Keep pre-AC1032 0x10 as raw-bit preservation only; do not call it native DWG frame-semantic support. Keep the existing AC1032 version/body-length tests and do not generalize the top-level rule to embedded MTEXT.

evidence.topic: DXF group 90 documentation/profile discrepancy is not evidence that frame mode is invalid
evidence.observed: Autodesk's current public DXF MTEXT table lists values 0/1/2. ezdxf 1.4.5 documents 3 and frame flag 16, citing ODA §20.4.46, and describes legacy pre-R2018 frame XDATA with linked LWPOLYLINE records that ezdxf does not preserve through its later load stage.
evidence.localObservation: Local DXF serializer/parser and generated tests treat group-90 frame-only and frame-plus-fill as separate from color-fill payload tags; legacy linked frame-XDATA remains a separate route.
evidence.disposition: Keep DXF group 90, native DWG flags, and legacy XDATA/linked-entity framing as separate versioned profiles. Do not infer rejection from Autodesk's abbreviated public table or use ezdxf normalized output as raw-XDATA truth.

evidence.topic: ACadSharp #1297 is a whole-document AC1032 acceptance report, not a proven entity-layout defect
evidence.observed: The reporter says AutoCAD 2025 Core Console rejects AC1032 with frame-only 0x10, accepts 0x11, and accepts frame-only AC1027. A rewritten file retaining matching MTEXT bytes still fails; absent VISUALSTYLE/section/detail-view styles are an unproved hypothesis.
evidence.localObservation: Existing local MTEXT vector tests qualify only record-body framing and local read/write behavior, not AutoCAD opening, audit, full object graph, or the cause of the peer rejection.
evidence.disposition: Retain the external whole-document gate and use matched complete-document 0x10/0x11 AC1032 controls with style/object inventories. Do not force 0x11 or fabricate style records.

evidence.topic: ACadSharp #1299 is an unlocalized SPLINE-to-GDAL failure lead
evidence.observed: The v3.8.0 reporter links a source DWG/output DXF pair and says GDAL GeoJSON conversion fails. No offending handle, knots/weights/control points, exact GDAL diagnostic/options, or independently expected curve is stated. The linked AI-chat explanation is not evidence; the ZIP could not be fetched.
evidence.localObservation: Existing PAR-22/7H/7I/7AB already require exact ordered curve fields and an independent analytic-point check; GDAL is only an optional projected-geometry consumer.
evidence.disposition: Do not add a peer-specific finding or block local work. If the archive becomes necessary, hash and inspect only in scratch, compare exact source/output arrays, bind GDAL version/options, and evaluate against independent curve expectations.

planImpact.fastNextAction: Continue the existing implementation queue. Reuse the focused DWG object-vector and DXF fixture MTEXT tests; reserve native whole-document acceptance and optional GDAL comparison for the existing composed checkpoints.
planImpact.qualificationBoundary: ODA body-layout rules, DXF profile observations, generated local serializer tests, peer application reports, independent SPLINE expectations, and native consumer acceptance are separate evidence classes.
